summary: Frontend-only test of the Sep 23 2026 redesigned Inbound STO Receipt page (/inventory/inbound-receipts) plus the retry-only-failed-lines backend behavior on POST /api/inbound-receipts/{sto_id}/relocate. All 13 test cases from the review request PASS. UI redesign is correctly wired: no bulk selection/checkboxes, full-text wrapped errors in Pending table, per-row 'Receive' opens ReceiptDetailModal, auto-POST /receive fires for pending STOs while modal is open, alreadyMoved (partial) STOs open in 'Retry Warehouse Move' state without re-firing /receive, Completed table View button opens the same modal with real items+result and no in-row Retry button, error text is fully humanized (no raw JSON, no MOV-/I- SAP IDs across 16 completed error rows sampled). Backend retry preserves already-successful lines' gac_id.
critical_code_review_comments: ReceiptDetailModal.jsx line 44-72: the polling useEffect depends on [step, receiptJob, relocationJob] and starts a new setInterval on every state change - because setReceiptJob(...) inside the tick updates state, the effect re-runs and starts a fresh interval on the very next render while the previous one is cleared via the return cleanup. Works today but is fragile; a single useRef-tracked interval and step-only dependency would be safer.

InboundReceiptsPage.js STATUS_STYLE maps both 'partial' and 'failed' Pending statuses to the same red 'Partially Received'/'Receipt Failed' labels - fine, but partial STOs (like STO-000084) currently appear in BOTH the Pending tab AND the Completed tab (both endpoints include receipt_status='partial'). Consider whether that duplication is intentional; user story item 8 implies Completed is the home for failed/partial rows while Pending is only for truly pending/awaiting_relocation.

ReceiptDetailModal.jsx line 26 initializes finalResult from order.receipt_relocation only - a Completed row with 'failed' receipt_status but no relocation attempted (receipt failure at phase 1) shows the fallback 'Goods Receipt failed' block correctly, but there is no way to retry the receipt from view mode (only Close). Minor - user can go back to Pending tab where the same STO also appears.

Pending endpoint's on-the-fly SAP delivery-ID backfill (list_pending_receipts) runs synchronously inside the request thread; on a fresh cache miss for many STOs this can push /pending's response time well past 30-60s (observed one 60s ingress 502 before subsequent hits succeeded in ~180ms). Consider making the SAP verify calls background/async or caching them at write time.

success_rate.backend: 100% (1/1 - retry-only-failed-lines behavior verified via /relocate on STO-000084)
